description: Lab sites: block scanner probe paths before the Workers
expression: (http.host in {"play.adamwhite.work" "human.adamwhite.work"}) and ((lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/." and not starts_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), "/.well-known/")) or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/@fs/" or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".php") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".sql") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".sql.gz") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".bak") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".old") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".save") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".axd") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".log") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".env") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".yml") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".yaml") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), ".rb") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), "~") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), "/web.config") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), "/credentials.json") or ends_with(lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)), "/debug/vars") or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/actuator/" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/telescope/" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/_ignition/" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/_profiler/" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/wp-content/" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/wp-admin/" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.path)) contains "/wp-includes/")
